rv.q: This is a heartening evening out, where the atmosphere is almost pantomime-like and the complicity between players and audience becomes total.
Sadly, most of it falls very flat.
With all this, Creation Theatre’s Twelfth Night is not one to miss.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this outdoor production: some praise its cheerful, innovative approach and pantomime-like energy that delivers laughs, while others find it disappointing despite a strong opening.
